name: Jerry
source: He used to be a creep who tried to harass [url=/c164397]Kelly[/url] at the arcade. However, he turned a new leaf after [url=/c164391]Max[/url] punched him in the face. He now works many different jobs; he is a Police Officer, a Lifeguard, and Store Staff. Additionally, while in Japan, he also works as a Waiter. Despite his past, he has become a very busy and hard-working person.
